rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for hostile or unauthorized entry, including physical invasion and cyberattacks.

example.english: The website suffered an intrusion by hackers, and all the data leaked.
example.traditional: 嗰個網站畀黑客入侵咗，資料全部外洩。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 mong5 zaam6 bei2 hak1 haak3 jap6 cam1 zo2 zi1 liu2 cyun4 bou6 ngoi6 sit3

rows.note: Use this for an unwelcome interruption or nuisance such as unsolicited sales calls, rather than forcible physical entry.

example.english: Those sales calls are a real intrusion.
example.traditional: 成日有推銷電話打嚟，真係好打擾。
example.jyutping: seng4 jat6 jau5 teoi1 siu1 din6 waa2 daa2 lai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 daa2 jiu2

rows.note: Use this more formal or technical word for penetration into a computer system or other protected space.

example.english: The system detected an intrusion into the internal network.
example.traditional: 系統偵測到有人侵入內部網絡。
example.jyutping: hai6 tung2 zing1 cak1 dou3 jau5 jan4 cam1 jap6 noi6 bou6 mong5 lok6
